results.name: Sci-Fi Bounty Hunter Girl - PNG to STL SupaVoxel
results.description:
Want this in your own style? Turn any image into a 3D model free → [supavoxel.com](https://supavoxel.com/?utm_source=sketchfab&utm_medium=ugc&utm_campaign=sofianakamura&utm_content=waifu-091)

Free download: sci-fi bounty hunter girl made from one flat illustration with SupaVoxel. Image in, textured 3D model out, nothing else touched.

Workflow: image -> SupaVoxel -> textured GLB -> this upload. Single mesh, PBR textures baked in, so it drops straight into Blender, Unity, Godot or a slicer for printing.

**Can I convert a PNG file to STL?** Yes: upload the PNG to SupaVoxel, export STL, and it goes straight into a slicer.

**What is the best 2D to 3D converter?** One that returns a clean, textured mesh from a single image. This model is raw SupaVoxel output - judge it yourself.

Free download, CC-BY - credit is enough. GLB, FBX, OBJ and STL conversions are in the Sketchfab download menu.
